main_switch2.description: Studio v1.3: everything in Studio v1.2, with 10 presets on the device instead of 5. The button cycles 1 to 10; presets 6 to 10 sit beside 1 to 5 (preset 8 shares the light colour of preset 3). A preset set to Custom keeps its own drawn curve and runs it with no app; while it is Custom its partner preset (3 and 8, for example) waits. Presets do not switch banks during a session. Safety limits are unchanged.
